words.definition: The part of the body above the neck that contains the brain.
words.example: She wore a warm hat on her head.
words.definition_es: Parte del cuerpo que está sobre el cuello.
words.example_es: Se puso un sombrero abrigador en la cabeza.

words.definition: The front part of the head, from forehead to chin.
words.example: He washed his face before breakfast.
words.example_es: Se lavó la cara antes de desayunar.

words.definition: The fine threads that grow on a person's head and body.
words.example: She brushed her long hair every morning.
words.definition_es: Filamentos que crecen en la cabeza y el cuerpo.
words.example_es: Se cepillaba el pelo largo cada mañana.

words.definition: The organ in the chest that pumps blood around the body.
words.example: Running made his heart beat faster.
words.definition_es: Órgano del pecho que bombea la sangre.
words.example_es: Correr hacía que su corazón latiera más rápido.

words.definition: A place where sick or injured people receive medical care.
words.example: They took the injured driver to the hospital.
words.definition_es: Lugar donde se atiende a personas enfermas.
words.example_es: Llevaron al conductor herido al hospital.

words.definition: A person who is receiving medical care.
words.example: The nurse checked on each patient every hour.
words.example_es: La enfermera revisaba a cada paciente cada hora.

words.example: The plant died because no one watered it.
words.example_es: La planta murió porque nadie la regó.

words.definition: An illness that affects people, animals, or plants.
words.example: Doctors work hard to prevent the spread of disease.
words.definition_es: Enfermedad que afecta a los seres vivos.
words.example_es: Los médicos trabajan para evitar el contagio de enfermedades.

words.definition: Medical care given to a patient for an illness or injury.
words.example: The treatment reduced her pain within days.
words.definition_es: Atención médica que se da a un paciente.
words.example_es: El tratamiento redujo su dolor en pocos días.

words.definition: To give medical care to a patient or illness.
words.example: The doctor treated the wound and gave her medicine.
words.definition_es: Dar atención médica a un paciente.
words.example_es: El médico trató la herida y le dio medicina.

words.definition: To experience pain, illness, or something unpleasant.
words.example: Many patients suffer from headaches after the surgery.
words.definition_es: Sentir dolor, enfermedad o algo desagradable.
words.example_es: Muchos pacientes padecen dolores de cabeza tras la cirugía.

words.definition: A substance used as a medicine to treat illness.
words.example: This drug lowers blood pressure effectively.
words.definition_es: Sustancia usada como medicina para tratar enfermedades.
words.example_es: Este medicamento baja la presión de forma eficaz.

words.example: His death was a shock to the whole town.
words.example_es: Su muerte fue un golpe para todo el pueblo.

words.definition: The part of the body used for seeing.
words.definition_es: Parte del cuerpo que sirve para ver.
words.example_es: Ella tiene ojos verdes y brillantes.
